title: Order States That Bear a Fee
content:
A fee is raised against a Lift Tickets order only while the order stands in the ordered, paid, issued, in use, cancelled or refunded state. The state is taken from the collective's own record of that order, read before the fee is raised and matched to the order the fee is raised against, rather than from what the household reports about the order.

**States in which a fee stands:** ordered, paid, issued, in use, cancelled, refunded.

**States in which no fee stands:** used up, expired, closed.

Because the rule names the fee-bearing states exhaustively, the second list follows from the first: those are the only states of a Lift Tickets order that the first list leaves out.

An order the household has given up still bears a fee, cancelled and refunded both being among the states named. An order that has had every day scanned, one that has run past its last valid date, and one that has been closed, bear none.
